name: Diwali Invitations
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Give the main line, who invites and the details you want printed, and pick the look: gold and maroon, glowing diyas, rangoli colors, elegant, minimal. You get an invitation with your words set in the design, portrait to print, tall to send from your phone, or square.

ChatGPT tells you what the invitation needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The invitation opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the invitation: no guest list or contact details are needed.

For families, friends, offices and community groups hosting a Diwali party, a puja or a festive dinner.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. Words are set in Latin letters, such as Diwali Celebration, not in Devanagari script. It does not send the invitations, keep guest lists or track replies. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
